title: 舞台用フォロースポットライト
description: 長い鏡筒、奥まったレンズ代替面、実際に中空のフード、後部通気スロットと格子、操作ハンドル、アイリス風レバー、焦点調整風ノブ、ヨークと左右支点を備えた三脚式の舞台用フォロースポット外観。レンズは不透明な青黒い材質で、光源・光束・投影・透過はありません。照準・支点・脚・操作部は固定です。舞台、天井、人物、電源ケーブルは含みません。内部光学系、ランプ、電気回路、冷却機構と細かなねじ山は省略。機器安全性、構造、電気・光学性能は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.054 × 1.768 × 1.111 m、22,184三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A theatrical followspot appearance assembly on a tripod pedestal, with elongated barrel, recessed lens placeholder, genuinely hollow hood, rear ventilation slots and grille, operator handle, iris-like lever, focus-like knob, yoke and paired trunnions. The lens is opaque blue-black material with no light source, beam, projection or transmission. Aiming, pivots, legs and controls are static. No stage, ceiling, person or power cable is included. Internal optics, lamp, circuits, cooling mechanism and fine screw threads are omitted. Equipment safety, structure and electrical/optical performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.054 × 1.768 × 1.111 m; 22,184 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
